items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I played with Charlie Johnson, yeah... I worked about a couple of months over there with him in Atlantic City. But when I came back to New York that winter, I went down and I worked that whole winter with him in New York, The Paradise.

ctx.x: How about Charlie Johnson's Band? Did you play with that band?
I played with Charlie Johnson, yeah, after -- I think I played with Charlie Johnson before, after I left my brother. That's when I think I got with Charlie. I went back home to Philly for a while.
And Charlie Johnson had heard me with my brother's band. See, Charlie Johnson always played Atlantic City too, every year. He came over to listen
